explanation: This question explicitly tests computing and evaluating the Jacobian matrix of a multivariable vector function, matching topic 4169, The Derivative of a Multivariable Function. Here J(x,y)=[[2-8x-y,-x],[y,x-1]], so J(0,0)=diag(2,-1). Its eigenvalues are 2 and -1, giving an unstable saddle.
